title: NEW: r5 batch-shape exclusion silently neutered the two stale-bounce pins — the typed timestamptz compare's FALSE branch is now unpinned
detail: same_day_stale_bounce_stands_down_test and stale_pre_correction_failure_stands_down_test (L958) fixture SINGLE-email entries; the r5 W1 predicate (email without sms sibling) now excludes them before the typed compare runs, so the stand-down is the exclusion, not the compare their comments claim to pin. No pair fixture has a pre-correction at — typed-FALSE is untested.
recommended_fix: Give at least one stale-bounce fixture a genuine email+sms pair with a pre-correction `at` (e.g. old_send_1 + sms sibling at now-1h), so a typed-compare regression (the r2 format-mix bug) turns CI red again.
